note: Generated by design/tools/icons.py. Unit space, y up, frame radius 1.0. Each icon is a list of layers drawn in order, all additive: glow {x,y,r,colour,i}; fill {pts,colours,grad,i}; lines {segs,colours,grad,i (HDR intensity),w (width in px at a 60 px icon radius)}; flare {x,y,len,colour,i,arms,rot,w}. grad is null (solid, first colour), [lin,x0,y0,x1,y1], [rad,cx,cy,r] or [ang,cx,cy,rot]; colours are evenly spaced stops. size scales the whole icon.
